name: Shin Taketori Monogatari
source:
Everyone knows The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter. But somewhere in the retelling, it was twisted — this was once a record of something that really happened.

On the far side of the moon, a woman lay sleeping. She wakes without words, her memory broken. The player traces what she lost, one fragment at a time, restoring pieces of a memory that gradually reveal the true story hidden beneath the folktale everyone thought they knew.

Choices made along the way shape which of several different endings the story reaches. The game is presented entirely in pixel art, with music and sound effects carrying much of its quiet, sound-novel-style storytelling.
translation:
《竹取物语》的故事人尽皆知。然而在世代口耳相传的过程中，真相遭到了扭曲——它原本曾是一桩真实发生过的往事的记录。

在月球的背面，一名女子正沉沉睡去。醒来后的她失去了言语，记忆也支离破碎。玩家将一片片追寻她遗失的过往，修复残破的记忆碎片，逐步揭开掩藏在那则世人自以为熟知的民间传说之下的真实故事。

旅途中作出的选择，将决定故事最终通向数个不同结局中的哪一方。全作完全采用像素美术呈现，借由配乐与音效承载起静谧深邃的有声小说式叙事体验。
